description: Tier 1 functional WAAPI tests for the Immerse Audio Renderer. Every assertion scenario is preceded by a 'setup' scenario that forces the property to the opposite value (so the assertion is guaranteed to be a real state transition). Wwise does not push when setProperty is called with the current value -- the test would silently FAIL because no log line is emitted by the plug-in.

scenarios.name: UserID: setup -> dummy (no-assert, forces state change)
UserID: assert switch back to expected

discovery_notes: ConvolutionType and HeadphoneEq were removed pending property-type discovery -- they expect numeric/enum values, not strings ('Value type does not match the property's type' from Wwise). Next step: query their live values + types via WAAPI ak.wwise.core.object.getPropertyAndReferenceNames or ak.wwise.core.object.get with options.return = ['@ConvolutionType', '@HeadphoneEq'] -- that returns the actual current value with its native type. Then re-add as proper assertion scenarios.
